verdict.rationale: Epic's own documentation describes Fab as an open marketplace for discovering, buying and selling ready-to-use digital assets for all developers, from students to AAA studios. The engine also has a documented plugin system that can add runtime features, extend the editor and be enabled per project, and one community comment credits Unreal's third-party and community support. Missing for 10: quantified evidence of catalog size, explicit evidence that tools and code plugins (not just assets) are distributed through Fab, independent or hands-on corroboration of the store's breadth and quality.
